narration.text: He has thirty songs past a billion streams. Thirty-five of the ninety-three rappers on the opening chart have zero. And eighty-one of the ninety-three don't have thirty billion streams across everything they've ever recorded.
narration.measuredTranscript: He has 30 songs past a billion streams. 35 of the 93 rappers on the opening chart have zero. And 81 of the 93 don't have 30 billion streams across everything they've ever recorded.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: Thirty of his songs passed a billion, while most of the field has nothing close.

claims.text: He has thirty songs past a billion streams.
Thirty-five of the ninety-three rappers have zero songs past a billion.
Eighty-one of the ninety-three have under thirty billion across everything.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: A grid of all 93 with the 35 and then the 81 highlightable as subsets of the same field.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: thirty songs past a billion streams

visualEvents.description: 35 of the 93 highlight within the full grid.
81 of the 93 highlight, replacing the previous subset.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not show the two subsets on different fields.
prohibitions.reason: Both counts are out of the same 93. Changing the denominator between them breaks the comparison.

successConditions: The viewer sees both subsets against the same 93.
The subsets are visibly different sizes.
failureConditions: The field size changes between the two counts.
The grid reads as fewer than 93.

groundTruth.desired: Artist grid highlighting 35 of 93, then 81 of 93
